situation: Passenger boarded at an unstaffed station early morning. Ticket office closed and the only ticket machine was out of order. No ticket on board.
decision: Allowed to travel; sold a ticket on board at the price from the departure station including Railcard discount. No Penalty Fare.

situation: Advance ticket for the 17:30. Arrived late because the connecting train was delayed 25 minutes, so took the 18:00 instead.
decision: Ticket accepted on the next service without penalty.

situation: Ticket bought with a 16-25 Railcard discount but the passenger had left the Railcard at home.
decision: Charged the fare difference; told the passenger they can claim a refund from customer service with their Railcard details (one claim per 12 months).

situation: Off-Peak return used on a peak-time train in the morning.
decision: Charged the difference between the Off-Peak fare and the cheapest ticket valid on that train. Not a Penalty Fare.

situation: Two tickets split at a station where the train did not call.
decision: Split not valid; treated as travelling without a valid ticket for that section and charged the single fare.
